findings.text: The submitted copy identifies the USGS National Water Information System daily values archive at `/source`. Its `/timeSeries/sourceInfo/siteName` identifies the Potomac River at the Little Falls Pump Station. The stored `/archive_query` also names a second station. Only Little Falls has a series in this file.

gaps: The second station’s direction and the difference between the stations’ proportional drops remain open pending the second archive copy.

qualitative_notes.text: Provenance transcription. `/source` reads `USGS National Water Information System, daily values (archived response)`. `/json_pointer` identifies `/value/timeSeries/0` in the parent response. The wrapper places this series at `/timeSeries`. Its `/archive_sha256` records the parent archive digest `03c1879879b8c2fdff492ae438cc0c3f3f968d186f30b6c30db533b44a7bd336`. The study manifest lists the submitted `first-station.json` digest as `4fe03052c201cd429d89fd29150c747099f72045efbbd65be5c2f68c144b279c`.

Station and coverage transcription. `/archive_query` lists `sites=01646500,01651000`, `parameterCd=00060`, `statCd=00003`, `startDT=2023-04-01`, and `endDT=2023-04-03`. The supplied `/timeSeries/name` is `USGS:01646500:00060:00003`. Under `/timeSeries/sourceInfo/siteCode/0`, `agencyCode` is `USGS`, `network` is `NWIS`, and `value` is `01646500`. `/timeSeries/sourceInfo/siteName` is `POTOMAC RIVER NEAR WASH, DC LITTLE FALLS PUMP STA`. Station `01651000` appears only in `/archive_query`.

Series definition transcription. `/timeSeries/variable/variableCode/0/value` is `00060`, `/timeSeries/variable/variableDescription` is `Discharge, cubic feet per second`, and `/timeSeries/variable/unit/unitCode` is `ft3/s`. Under `/timeSeries/variable/options/option/0`, `name` is `Statistic`, `optionCode` is `00003`, and `value` is `Mean`.

Daily record transcription. In each of the following row objects, the fields are `dateTime`, `value`, and `qualifiers/0`, respectively. `/timeSeries/values/0/value/0` contains `2023-04-01T00:00:00.000`, `9980`, `A`. `/timeSeries/values/0/value/1` contains `2023-04-02T00:00:00.000`, `9230`, `A`. `/timeSeries/values/0/value/2` contains `2023-04-03T00:00:00.000`, `8630`, `A`. Under `/timeSeries/values/0/qualifier/0`, `qualifierCode` is `A` and `qualifierDescription` reads `Approved for publication -- Processing and review completed.`

Taking the April 1 mean as the baseline, the April 1–3 drop at Little Falls is 9,980 − 8,630 = 1,350 ft³/s, or about 13.5% (100 × 1,350 / 9,980). The endpoint fields are `/timeSeries/values/0/value/0/value` and `/timeSeries/values/0/value/2/value`.
